t: Dine tzitzit sheasaan nokri venashim vetallit sheula
s: Dine tzitzit sheasaan nokri venashim vetallit sheula ubo t"v seipim: nokri shehetil tzitzit bebeged — pasul, shenneemar: "dabber el bene yisrael veasu lahem tzitzit vego'" — bene yisrael yaasu tzitzit al hakkanap, velo nokri:

Haishsha keshera lehatil tzitzit bebeged, mippene shehi biklal "bene yisrael". Veyesh medammin tzitzit litpillin, kemo shehannashim pesulot liktob [tepillin] mippene sheena[n] chayyab[ot] bahanachatan kemo sheyyitbaer besiman lat — kak hen pesulot lehatil tzitzit bebeged, mippene sheenan chayyab[ot] bemitzvat tzitzit. Ulepi dibrehem ap qatan pasul lehatil tzitzit bebeged, vaapillu im haggadol omed al gabbayv veomer lo sheyyaaseh leshem mitzvat tzitzit. Abal hatteviyya vehashshezira — kasher benashim uqetannim apillu lekattechilla, ledibre hakkol. Vahalaka kassebara harishona, umikkol maqom tob lizzaher lekattechilla kassebara haacharona:

Im hetil yisrael tzitzit bebeged shello bekavvana, perush shello nitkavven leshem mitzvat tzitzit — yesh mi sheomer diksherim hem, mippene sheim i atta omer ken lamma hutzrak hakkatub lipsol et hannokri shello yatil tzitzit bebeged, shehare nokri eno mitkavven leshem mitzvat tzitzit. Abal yesh omerim sheim hetil yisrael tzitzit bebeged belo kavvana — pesulim. Velo hutzrak hakkatub lipsol et hannokri, ella im yisrael omed al gabbayv umesayyea immo veomer lo sheyyaaseh leshem tzitzit — apillu hake pesulim. Veken halaka. Umikkol maqom bishat haddechaq, [kegon] sheen lo tallit acheret metzuyyetzet (kehilkatah), vegam i epshar lo lehattir hatztzitzit velachazor velahatilam battallit bekavvana, kegon shehu shabbat — yesh lismok al sebara harishana, veyilbash tallit zo abal lo yebarek aleha, dibrakot enan meakkebot:

Hashshoel mechabero tallit sheenah metzuyyetzet — patur millehatil bah tzitzit kol sheloshim yom, shenneemar: "kesuteka" — shelleka, abal lo shel acherim. Abal leachar sheloshim — chayyab lehatil bah tzitzit midderabbanan, mippene shennireh keshello. Veellu sheloshim yom tzerikim lihyot retzupim, abal im hechezirah lehabbealim tok sheloshim yom vechazar ushealah mimmennu — eno mitztarep, ella moneh hashsheloshim yom mishsheila hashsheniyya:

Im rotzeh lehatil bah tzitzit tok sheloshim yom ulebarek alayv — hareshut beyado veenah beraka lebattala. Veap al pi shehu patur min haddabar — yakol lomar "vetzivvanu lehitattep", kemo shehannashim mebarekin al kol hammitzvot shehen peturot mehem, mittaam sheyyitbaer besiman yaz ayyen sham:

Hashshoel mechabero tallit metzuyyetzet — chayyab lebarek alayv miyyad, mishshum deaddaatta dehake hishilo lo sheyyebarek alayv, vekevan shei epshar sheyyebarek beraka hamchuyyebet al tallit sheula — anan sahade denitkavven hammashil belashon hammoil, veim i epshar lo lebarek alayv ella im ken hi shello — hare hi shello bemattana al menat lehachazir:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Betallit hamyuchedet lemitzvat tzitzit, kegon tallit gadol o mah sheqqorin arba kenapot, debazeh vadday lo maqneh lo ella kede laasot hammitzva ulebarek alayv, velaken have keillu netanah lo bemattana al menat lehachazir. Abal hammashil lachabero malbush shel arba kenapot, sheadam lobesh oto derek malbush bealma velo leshem mitzvat tzitzit, ella shemmetil bo tzitzit mippene sheyyesh bo arba kenapot — en hashshoel tzarik lebarek alayv, mishshum deen lanu berur shehishilo leshem mitzva shennomar dahava keillu netanah lo bemattana al menat lehachazir, deshemma lemalbush bealma hishilo. Abal im yirtzeh lebarek — hareshut beyado, kemo shennitbaer leel:

Hashshoel mechabero tallit metzuyyetzet kede laalot laddukan o laalot liqrot beseper tora o lered lipne hatteba, im hammashil yodea shehashshoel lobesho leshem mitzvat tzitzit — im ken addaatta dehake hishilo sheyyebarek alayv, vahave keillu netanah lo bemattana al menat lehachazir, velaken mebarek alayv hashshoel beraka mechuyyebet keillu hayeta shello mammash. Abal im en bedaat hammashil shehashshoel lobeshah leshem mitzvat tzitzit, raq shehu sober sheeno lobesho ella mippene kebod hatztzibbur — im ken en alenu lomar dahave keillu natan lo bemattana al menat lehachazir, velaken en tzarik hashshoel lebarek aleha beraka mechuyyebet, raq im yirtzeh lebarek — hareshut beyado kemo shennitbaer leel:

Muttar lehitattep betallit shel chabero shello middato, veeno keshoel shello middaat deniqra gazlan, kevan delekka haka chashash killuy qarna, sheeno mitattep bah ella lepi shaa umachazirah lo achar kak, venicha leh leinish sheyyeaseh mitzva bemamono bemaqom sheen sham chesron kis. Ella deim matza hattallit mequppelet — tzarik hu gam ken leqappelah leachar sheyyesirenna mealayv, deim lo yeqappelenna yaqpid baal hattallit, vahava shoel shello middaat deniqra gazlan. Veen tzarik leqappelah keseder [qippulo] harishon davqa, ella apillu im meqappel beinyan acher — day bekak. Ubeshabbat — en tzarik leqappelo kelal. Veayyen siman shab:

Lo hittiru lehitattep betallit shel chabero shello middato ella beaqray bealma, abal biqbiut — asur, shemma yaqpid baal hattallit. Vaapillu beaqray lo hittiru lehitattep ella bemaqom shehinnichu bealim, abal lo yotzienna meoto maqom lemaqom acher, kegon mibbet hakkeneset lebeto o mibbet bealim lebet hakkeneset, vaapillu yachazor veyannichennu bemaqom shennetalah sham — asur, dela nicha leh leinish sheyyetaltelu chapatzayv bemaqom sheen meyuchadim lo:

Keshemmitattep betallito shel chabero shello middato — en tzarik lebarek alayv, shehare kan lo shayyak lomar dahava keillu natan lo bemattana al menat lehachazir, kevan sheen baal hattallit yodea meuma. Abal im yirtzeh lebarek — hareshut beyado, kemo shennitbaer leel saip v, ch, t ayyen sham:

Veken muttar lehitlabbesh beaqray bealma bitpillin shel chabero shello middato, vetzarik lebarek alehem, mippene shehattepillin chobat haggup hem, veen tzarik sheyyihyu hattepillin shello davqa. Raq yizzaher sheyyeqappelen im metzaan mequppalim veshello yotzien mimmaqom shehunchu sham, shemma yaqpid alayv baal hattepillin, vahava mitzva habbaa baabera:

Separim shel chabero — asur lilmod bahen shello middato apillu beaqray bealma, mishshum debaal hasseparim choshesh shemma yiqra bahen harbeh ad sheyyiqqareu merob mishmusham, ubishbil kak lo nicha leh sheyyilmod bahem kelum (veim hipqid separim etzel talmid chakam — ayyen bechoshen mishpat siman ratzab saip k. Ayyen sham):

Keshem shettallit sheula enah betorat chiyyub tzitzit — kak tzitzit sheulin enan tzitzit kelal veenan poterin et habbeged, shenneemar: "veasu lahem" — mishshellahem. Veenan niqrain sheulin ella im ken hitna immo hammashil sheyyachazir lo otan hachutin beatzman sheshshealam mimmennu, abal im eno tzarik lehachazir lo otan hachutin beatzman — en zeh niqra sheila ella halvaa, vahare hem keshello mammash. Velaken muttar lehatil otam babbeged apillu lekattechilla. Vaapillu hitna im hammashil sheyyachazir lo otan hachutin atzman — apillu hake enan pesulin, ella im ken en hammashil yodea shehu shoel otam mimmennu leshem tzitzit, raq shehu sober sherotzeh laasot bahem melaka acheret, abal im hammashil yodea shehashshoel rotzeh lehatil hachutin babbeged leshem tzitzit veaddaata dehake hishilam lo — muttar hashshoel lehatil babbeged vaapillu lekattechilla, dahava keillu netanah lo bemattana al menat lehachazir, ukemo shennitbaer leel gabbe tallit sheula besaip z:
Tallit shel shuttapin — chayyebet betzitzit, shenneemar: "al kanpe bigdehem vego'" — leshon rabbim, lerabbot shel shuttapin:
